assets.alt: Six-panel hexagonal infographic: The Biblical WorldModel -- Two Sources One Story, The Starting Point Matters, Calculated Age vs Actual History, Two Case Studies, Process Behavior vs Object History, A Fair and Open Inquiry.
assets.notes: A complete, standalone composed infographic supplied by JD via chat upload 2026-09-12, not a crop from references/graphics-asset-sheet.png -- unlike every other asset in this library, it has no source sheet and was not extracted or regenerated; the file is stored exactly as supplied. Content review (same date): the graphic's vocabulary (K-Ar/Rb-Sr dating terms, 'auxiliary assumptions') is Tier 3 register per WP-BWM-0005's tier standard, not Tier 1; JD accepted it 2026-09-12 as a high-level overview story rather than requesting a rewrite. Panel 2's naturalistic/BWM comparison columns are not fully symmetric (naturalistic side lists descriptive premises, BWM side includes evaluative conclusions) -- flagged, not corrected here. Panel 4's Mt. St. Helens (350,000-2.8 Ma K-Ar) and Cardenas Basalt (~1.1 Ga) figures have not been verified against primary geochronological sources, which WP-BWM-0005 requires before public use of those specific case studies.
assets.approval: Storage authorized by JD, 2026-09-12, accepted as a high-level story; production/public-use disposition for the flagged content items not yet given.

assets.alt: Table titled Exemplars for a Christian Methodological Designism: eleven exemplars (Jesus Christ, the Apostles, Van Til, Aristotle, Socrates, Aquinas, Reid, Plantinga, Godel, Lakatos, Bayes), each with key contributions, primary role, BWM layers, distinctive value and key caution; below, an integrated-contribution diagram and a mapping from Revelation through Methodology, Research Programmes and Models to Predictions and Dispositions.
assets.notes: A standalone composed graphic supplied by JD via chat upload 2026-09-25 (prepared as a repository-ready JPEG by another assistant), stored exactly as supplied: not extracted, edited or regenerated. Its exemplar list matches WP-BWM-0030's 'Methodological exemplars' section. Flagged, not corrected: Alvin Plantinga's lifespan is printed as (1932-2023), but he is living (turned 93 in November 2025); portrait images are illustrations, not verified likenesses. Correct both before public use.
